svg.title: Private play area (WIP)
svg.desc: 40 × 40 cm play mat. All emoji and lettering are vector paths; no bitmap images or font dependencies. Lettering outlined from Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono Regular, licensed under SIL OFL 1.1. A repeating text-like grid of shushing-face emoji, set at the same 10 mm character size as the label, sits behind it. The background uses opacity 0.8; the label and repeating emoji are fully opaque.
svg.metadata: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono © 2020–2024 The Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono Project Authors. https://github.com/googlefonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-mono — https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/ Shushing-face artwork: Twemoji, © Twitter, Inc. and contributors, CC BY 4.0. https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji/blob/main/assets/svg/1f92b.svg — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Adapted to a repeating 10 mm vector pattern; ellipse converted to a path.
